description: Existing pinned-Musashi differential evidence, by exact primary word and by aspect actually compared. semantic_validated_words: any Musashi-compared result state. ccr_sr_validated_words: the test compares SR/CCR (batch B/C compare d,a,pc,sr,ram; MUL/DIV, CMP-absolute and PC-indexed logical compare SR&0x1F). ea_side_effect_validated_words: the test compares the full D and A register files and memory after the instruction (batch B/C only); LEA/ADDA/MOVEA single-vector tests compare one address register and are not listed. A form is validated for an aspect only if every one of its words is listed. Timing validation is empty: no existing test compares generated timing against an oracle. UNDEFINED FLAGS (SEG-021-T015): for ABCD, SBCD and NBCD the N and V condition codes are undefined on the base MC68000; their ccr_sr_validated credit covers X/C/Z as documented semantics, and N/V only as the deliberate matched-to-Musashi policy (not documented behavior).
